arguments.decision_needed: The tenant reports the landlord's LG washing machine (there when they moved in) has stopped working with a power failure; they say it can't be repaired (their own web search, not diagnosed). They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost, which would remain their property and be taken with them when they leave. This needs your consent. Please tell us: (1) do you consent to the tenant fitting their own machine; (2) what should happen to your existing machine (we inspect/repair, dispose, or you collect it); (3) who pays to disconnect and remove the old machine and fit the new one; (4) or would you prefer we send our contractor to inspect and repair/replace yours?
options: Send our contractor to inspect the existing machine first (recommended, as the fault is undiagnosed)
Consent to tenant's own machine, tenant-owned and not on the inventory; say what happens to the old machine and who pays for removal/fitting
Landlord arranges own contractor or replacement

arguments.body: Thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. We've logged it as a routine job. Fitting your own machine needs the landlord's consent, so we've asked them, and we've noted that a machine you buy stays yours and goes with you when you leave. We've also asked what should happen to the existing machine and who covers removal and fitting. Please don't remove or dispose of the old machine until we confirm. If you can, send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you by 30 July at the latest.

If you can, send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you by 30 July at the latest.
